openai-api-docs.note: Official docs confirm exact gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-luna text input/output, 1,050,000 context, 128,000 maximum output, POST https://api.openai.com/v1/responses and Authorization: Bearer. Responses output message output_text and input_tokens/output_tokens with reasoning token details. Documentation is not per-account availability or live proof. This build admits buffered text only; tools, native streaming, structured output and reasoning control remain absent.

openai-web-search-tool.source: OpenAI API documentation, web search tool guide and models page, developers.openai.com/api/docs
openai-web-search-tool.note: Server-side in the Responses API — `"tools": [{"type": "web_search"}]` — with `url_citation` annotations and a `sources` list; the models page lists Web search in every flagship's tools row (ADR 0080 §3).

routes.note: Buffered text only with max_output_tokens 8192. The explicit synthetic connection test narrows this to 512; neither probe nor saved credential proves tools or native streaming.

openQuestions: Account/model access requires the editor-initiated exact-binding text test; no live access was tested by Issue #1044.
Function tools, opaque reasoning replay, structured outputs, reasoning control and native streaming remain unadmitted.
429/account denial is classified by the existing adapter; AI7 does not automatically retry or choose another binding.
